chapter.title: Start Here
subtitle: Spring, Year One.
Eight small things. The last one brings the first neighbour up the hill.

quests.title: Read Josie's Letter
quests.subtitle: The last page is a map.
description: Josie: “If you're reading this I'm dead and the valley is cold. Only one of those is your problem.”
Take Josie's Letter out of your bag and right-click it. Read all four pages — the last one tells you where the old Kettle farm is.
Forty lamp posts stand along the road out of here and not one of them is lit. That is the whole job.

tasks.title: Josie's Letter read — all four pages

rewards.title: Found on the Mantle
rewards.description: Next: follow the road from where you woke up. It ends at the Kettle farm gate. Put the waystone on the flat grey hearthstone in the middle of the kitchen floor.

quests.title: Put the Waystone on the Hearthstone
quests.subtitle: Name it Home.
description: Josie: “The hearthstone is the one thing in that house I never had to fix. Start from the part that held.”

Follow the road from where you woke up to the old farm — the gate is signposted and the chimney is standing. The house is standing too: cold, empty, no door on it. Place the Homestead Waystone on the flat grey hearthstone in the middle of the kitchen floor, type Home in the box, click the tick.
Nothing is rebuilt and nothing is moved. It is your house from that moment, exactly as she left it.

tasks.title: Homestead Waystone standing on the hearthstone, named Home

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "Start from the part that held.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:ui.toast.challenge_complete master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Home
rewards.description: Next: the door, the two windows, the bed and the sconce are in your bag. The holes they go in are already in the walls.

quests.title: Hang the Door, Windows, Bed and Sconce
quests.subtitle: All four are in your bag. The holes are already there.
description: Josie: “A house is a box until somebody shuts a door in it. Go and shut the door.”

The doorway is empty, two window holes are open to the weather, there is a wool mat where the bed goes and a hook by the door. Put the Oak Cottage Door in the doorway, one Oak Window in each hole, the Red Bed on the mat and the Sconce on the hook. Any order is right.
The cottage becomes a home you can cook in, and the smoke from it is what brings Marnie up the hill.

tasks.title: Door, two windows, bed and sconce placed

rewards.title: Four Walls and a Door
rewards.description: Next: place the Megatorch inside the cottage. Then the soup.

quests.title: Place the Megatorch Inside the Cottage
quests.subtitle: One torch. It never goes out.
description: Josie: "The dark out here has opinions. The tall torch settles them, permanently, and you never think about it again."
Place the Megatorch on the cottage floor, inside the walls, where you can see it from the bed.
Nothing hostile spawns near home from now on — not tonight, not in December.

rewards.title: Nothing Gets In
rewards.description: Next: two spare Megatorches are for the pens. Now dig out the cellar stairs.

quests.title: Dig Out the Cellar Stairs
quests.subtitle: Forty marked blocks of gravel in the kitchen floor.
description: Josie: “There's a door down there I'm not going to explain yet. Dig anyway; I know you.”

There is a patch of gravel in the kitchen floor, two blocks wide, and it goes down. Dig it out — forty marked blocks — and you will be standing on a stone stair she cut herself. The iron shovel is in your bag.
At the bottom: a sealed iron door, no handle, four words in her chalk — Not yet. — J.K. Beside it, a plinth for the Cellar Waystone and her tool chest.

tasks.title: Standing in the cellar, at the bottom of the flight

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "No handle. Her chalk still on it.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: The Door Under the House
rewards.description: Next: hang the Copper Kettle and cook one Vegetable Soup. The door has no handle and no keyhole, and the chalk on it is not old.

quests.title: Cook One Vegetable Soup
quests.subtitle: Kettle on the hook, pot on the fire.
description: Josie: "Kettle on the hook, soup in the pot — that is the entire ceremony. There has never been a bigger one."

Put the campfire outside your door, hang the Copper Kettle on the hook above it, and cook one Vegetable Soup in the Cooking Pot — a pot only cooks over lit fire. Cabbage, carrots and potatoes are in the basket; three planks make four bowls.
Bram's old Surveyor's Stake is in the vegetable basket, wrapped in a rag with a chalk K on it — the next quest is what you do with it.

rewards.title: Put the Kettle On
rewards.description: Next: carry Bram's Surveyor's Stake up the road to the square and drive it into the socket he cut for it.

quests.title: Drive the Surveyor's Stake into Bram's Socket
quests.subtitle: It is cut into the middle of the square. It has been for forty years.
description: Josie: “Bram surveyed that flat by the road twice, cut the socket for the stake, and never drove it — forty years of nearly. Drive it.”
Walk up the road to the square. There is a chiselled socket in the paving two blocks north of the town waystone, with Bram's own sign beside it. Put the Surveyor's Stake in it.

Nothing moves and nothing is built. The square, the streets and the empty houses round it have been standing since long before you got here — what changes is that the town is on the record again, and the two lamps at the head of the High Street come on.

tasks.title: Surveyor's Stake driven into the socket on the square

rewards.command: title @p subtitle {"text": "This is where the town will be.", "color": "gray", "italic": true}
execute at @p run playsound minecraft:block.bell.resonate master @p ~ ~ ~ 1 1

rewards.title: Lantern Road 2/40
rewards.description: Next: sleep one night in your own bed. Marnie has been watching that chimney for four years.

quests.title: Sleep One Night in Your Bed
quests.subtitle: Marnie sees the chimney.
description: Marnie: “Four years I've looked at that chimney, and last night there was smoke. I've brought bread and I am not carrying it home.”
Sleep one night in the Red Bed in your cottage.
Marnie unlocks the inn she has kept with no guests in it and moves back in, Bram opens the mill, and she leaves you her seed sack, 32 Green Oak Planks and a flint and steel.

tasks.title: Slept one night in the cottage bed

rewards.title: Residents 1/15
rewards.description: Next: till the 3x9 patch behind the house — every tile is marked. Bram is at the mill west of the square; he has waited sixty years, he can wait a week.
